meta.description: Typed GenAI skills ontology: one vocabulary of skills (concepts, methods, concrete technologies and non-technical skills) with aliases, implements links, parents, choose-one classes, statuses and corpus-match rules; per-role tiered links with evidence; credentials; resume variants. Source of truth for career/03-skills-and-tech/skills-vocabulary.md, career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-inventories.md and career/06-job-search/resume-skills-matrix.md.

sources.tiers: career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-maps.md (skill tiers and evidence tags) and the research sessions cited per link
sources.posting_shares: JobsPipe job-description measurements retrieved 2026-11-02 (Grade B); S09 corpus shares from T0-03 §6.3 (Grade B)
sources.statuses: career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-maps.md §5 registry (T0-03, T0-11, T0-16); class V2 facts, re-verify by 2027-01-21
sources.target_order: career/02-roles/genai-target-roles.md (consensus of eight lenses, GenAI-restricted demand)
sources.devalued: T0-03 §4.3 (what to deprioritise) and §6.8.2 (skills undergoing devaluation); grades as the session gives them; tool facts as of 2026-10-23, re-verify by 2027-01-21

ttl.rule: EGP-1.0 class V2: platform and product facts re-verified within 90 days of 2026-10-23

tiers.M: Must: Screen gate: role-defining or named in most postings (basic qualifications). Skills section + evidence in a recent role or project.
tiers.I: Important: Differentiators that win interviews and level (preferred qualifications). Show as evidence with a metric.
tiers.S: Should: Common supporting skills. List if true, in the JD wording.
tiers.O: Optional: Employer-specific or frontier. Include only when the JD names it.
tiers.X: Avoid: Devalued, deprecated or counter-productive items. Leave out, or reframe.

evidence.JD: Share of live postings for the title that name the skill (JobsPipe, retrieved 2026-11-02). Grade B
evidence.S09: Share of the 3,647-posting S09 corpus (198 companies, 2026-08-05; skews senior/infra), T0-03 §6.3. Grade B
evidence.S: Named for the role in a research session or in a real job description cited there; src gives session:line. Grade A, B or C as stated
evidence.P: Practice-curated: standard for the role but not evidenced in the corpus; check against 10-20 live postings before investing heavily. Grade D

verifiability.V1: Reproducible: one command regenerates the results; pinned versions; CI linked

verification.links: 1529 role links across 26 roles; evidence JD 154 · S09 31 · S 679 · P 665
verification.posting_shares: all 154 JD shares matched to their title's row in career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-maps.md §2.1; all 31 S09 shares matched to §2.2 and to the cited T0-03 line
verification.session_citations: all 679 S citations point at an existing session line that names the item; candidate lines were scored for role relevance (role keyword on or near the line, terms from the note, table or bullet rows), weak knowledge-skill citations at Should or Optional were downgraded to P (11), and the remaining low-relevance lines plus a random sample of 40 were read and 40 were replaced with exact lines or downgraded
verification.rules: every role covers all 19 types or states why a type does not apply; archived, dormant and retired tools and retired credentials are tiered Avoid; every change to a headline tier carries a reason
verification.limits: the planned independent agent fact-check of every link was blocked by the model quota on 2026-11-04, so citations matched by keyword can still be weaker than a close reading; tool tiers outside the measured titles rest on session mentions and practice curation until job-description mining (30+ dated postings per role) measures them
